offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and services pumps, valves and mechanical seals for industrial fluid handling. Sells mainly to process industries such as oil and gas, chemicals and power, through direct sales, service centers and aftermarket support.

primary_products.value: pumps; valves; mechanical seals; actuators; control systems

primary_services.value: equipment repair; field service; maintenance programs; equipment upgrades; engineered project services

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas operators, refiners, chemical and petrochemical plants, power generators, water utilities, mining and pulp companies

end_markets.value: oil and gas; chemicals; power generation; water; mining; pulp and paper

revenue_model.value: product sales: pumps, valves and seals sold to industrial plant owners and contractors; service fees: aftermarket repair, maintenance and field service for installed equipment; project or contract: engineered equipment packages and long-term service agreements for plant projects
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds pumps, valves and seals from purchased castings and components, sold to industrial plant owners; service provider: repairs, maintains and upgrades installed rotating and flow control equipment for plant operators

geography_served.value: global: Manufacturing and service operations across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Asia Pacific and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: pumps, valves, mechanical seals and aftermarket services sharing industrial plant customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales engineers selling to large industrial accounts and engineering contractors; own locations: company-operated service centers and repair shops near customer plants; distributors / dealers: independent industrial distributors serving smaller plants and regional customers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Pressure equipment design and safety codes, emissions and environmental rules, and export controls on industrial equipment
